publications.name: The Long War – Codex Supplement Black Templars

rules.name: Crusade Unending
rules.description:
The following restrictions apply to the bitter crusaders of the Black Templars:
• Black Templars units may never voluntarily Go to Ground.
• A Black Templars army must contain at least 1 unit of Crusader Squad for every 1000pts.
• Black Templars Space Marines Lieutenant may not purchase the Librarian option and no Black Templar unit in your army may have the Psyker (x) special rule.
• Black Templars Space Marines Captains may not purchase the Chapter Master option.

rules.name: Templars Vow
rules.description:
A Black Templars army must select 2 of the following Vows at the beginning of the Game, after deployment but before the first turn begins:
“Suffer not the Unclean to live”:
All Black Templars gain the Crusader special rule
“Uphold the honour of the Emperor”:
All Black Templars gain the Stubborn special rule.
“Abhor the Witch, Deny the Witch”:
All Black Templars gain the Indomitable Spirit (5+) special rule.
“Accept any challenge, no matter the odds”:
All Black Templars gain the Zealot special rule.
In addition, ‘Sword Brother’ models in your army may purchase Relic Wargear as if they had the Character special rule.

sharedRules.name: Martial Feats
sharedRules.description:
Each Combat Phase, at initiative Step 10 of a combat, a unit with this special rule may select one of the following Martial feats and gains the associated benefit until the end of the phase:
• Riposte: Engaged enemy units gain the Gets Hot! special rule on all equipped Melee Weapons.
• Block: The unit gains the Feel No Pain (6+) special rule.
• Flurry of Blows: The unit gains the Arcing (6+) special rule on all equipped Melee Weapons.
If a unit with this special rule includes an attached unit with this special rule as well, the attached unit may select a different Martial Feat to the main unit.

rules.name: The Eternal Crusader
rules.description: Before the first Battle Round begins, after determining who will take the first turn, roll a D6 for each enemy unit on the battlefield. On a 6, they are hit by one of the guns from the orbiting Eternal Crusader and take D6+2, Strength 7, AP3 hits. If a unit is a Fortification, it is hit on a 5 or a 6 instead.
